name: Abdominal (mãos acima da cabeça)
instructionsEn: Settle onto your back with your knees bent and feet planted.
Reach your arms straight above your head.
Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

Reach one leg forward, keeping it off the ground.
Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: Agachamento unilateral (pistol)
instructionsEn: Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and arms extended in front of you.
Before moving, lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward.
Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Extend the free leg ahead of you as you squat on the standing leg, keeping its heel grounded.
Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: Agachamento unilateral com barra
instructionsEn: Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a barbell across your upper back.

Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: Agachamento unilateral com halter

Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: Agachamento zercher com barra
instructionsEn: Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and toes slightly turned out.

Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.

name: Alongamento circular de joelhos
instructionsEn: Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and your hands on your hips.
Before moving, bend your knees slightly and lift your heels off the ground, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: Alongamento cruz de ferro
